title: Collective Bargaining Agreement Between the District and United Administrators of Oakland Schools (UAOS)
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education of Tentative Agreement, as Agreement Between District and United Administrators of Oakland Schools (UAOS), representing Certificated and Classified Administrators, for the period July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2022, which includes a 5% on-going salary increase for unit non-retirees effective July 1, 2020, a 5% salary increase effective January 1, 2020 for unit employees at time of UAOS ratification who retire on or before June 30, 2020 and bonuses, as described therein.
headline: Approves a three-year contract with the administrators' union, including 5% raises
summary: The Board is adopting a tentative labor agreement with United Administrators of Oakland Schools, the union for certificated and classified administrators, covering July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2022. It includes a 5% ongoing raise for current employees starting July 1, 2020, a 5% raise starting January 1, 2020 for employees who retire by June 30, 2020, and bonuses. The text does not state a dollar cost.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Salary Adjustment - Unrepresented Employees, Confidential Employees and Employees With Contracts - Effective July 1, 2020
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 1920-0264 - Salary Adjustment Effective July 1, 2020 For Unrepresented Employees, Confidential Employees, and Employees With Employment Contracts, as delineated herein, i.e., a 5% one-time off schedule increase and a 5% ongoing increase effective July 1, 2020.
headline: Gives unrepresented and contract employees a 5% one-time payment and 5% ongoing raise
summary: This resolution sets salary adjustments effective July 1, 2020 for employees who are not covered by a union contract, confidential employees, and employees with individual employment contracts. It provides a 5% one-time payment that is not added to the salary schedule and a 5% ongoing raise. The text does not state a dollar cost.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
